description: Read-only OpenClaw policy for authorizing the epac release-manager path before App Store submission or release actions.

testflight_upload.notes: Build upload/processing is allowed because it does not submit or release the App Store version.

phased_release_continue.notes: Continuation is a release-manager action and needs a human confirmation, but not the previous-version 24-hour age gate.

emergency_hotfix_release.notes: May bypass the 24-hour gate only with an explicit emergency or human-approved override receipt.

sourceOfTruthOrder.name: app_store_connect_app_store_version
sourceOfTruthOrder.notes: Primary source. Use App Store Connect appStoreVersions/appStoreState plus the timestamp at which the previous version reached an accepted terminal state.

sourceOfTruthOrder.name: github_release_metadata
sourceOfTruthOrder.notes: Fallback only when App Store Connect is unavailable. The release-manager receipt must identify the GitHub release/tag used.

sourceOfTruthOrder.name: linear_release_issue_status
sourceOfTruthOrder.notes: Fallback only when App Store Connect is unavailable and a Linear release issue records the reviewed/released timestamp.

sourceOfTruthOrder.name: manual_release_receipt
sourceOfTruthOrder.notes: Last-resort documented fallback for demos or credential outages; it must be public-safe.
